sections.heading: Bottom-up estimates
sections.markdown:
FY2025: 756,368t (F19) at $337.7/t (F21/F19) = $255.4m + LPG $36.1m (F22) + other $3.5m = $295.0m (F1); the FY2022 fall of $436.5m is price (realised $929→$337.7/t), volume 740→756kt. Audited EBIT $77.0/$82.0/$70.8m (FY2023-25). Costs escalate with Brent (59% of COGS exposed, 65% passed through).

Earnings quality: accruals (NI−CFO)/assets −7.3%/−11.9%/−13.7% (FY2025/24/23), cash ahead; receivables +43.8% ($21.5m→$31.0m, F47/F48) on revenue −2.1%, 79.7% Genesis (F49). IDX clean: unmodified, no notation, 9M-26 unaudited, no PSAK 16 reval. Related-party revenue 86.58% (F26), Akraya $8.87m (F25), no rights issue (F30), public sub-5% 54.08% (F45).

sections.heading: Valuation, entry and fillability
sections.markdown: Through-cycle NAV: FCFF DCF, WACC 10.86%, g 2.0%, Rp19,000/USD (model block). Feedstock $153.7/t (F24/F19) against a European TTF marginal cost above $550/t; net cash / bear EBITDA −1.3x. The 493 kill sat 0.6% under the tape — re-derived below.

sections.heading: House coverage reconciliation
sections.markdown: Within 4%: my Rp829 against the house Rp802.5 (engine Rp827.4; DCF Rp909.9 at spot FX 18,080, 33.1% gross margin in perpetuity, terminal $85.1m at 2%). I deduct more on the 30% PAU minority ($262m of $873m EV against the house's $244.9m) and decline the Rp941 blend — a quarter is the house bull Rp1,637.

sections.heading: Microstructure and liquidity
sections.markdown: Free float 51.51% (IDX-IC mirror, 2026-11-04); the AR's public sub-5% line 54.08% (F45). 3-month ADTV Rp57.0bn (datapack, 2026-11-05); no 30-day figure (`the liquidity feed` empty), so 3m is the only sourced number and the "thin" tag in `the INDO universe` is stale (28x the Rp2bn floor). Band 25% (`the fund rules` 184). Flows stale: no `fund record` entry.

sections.heading: Priors disclosure
sections.markdown: Before documents: the market reads ESSA as a spent 2022 ammonia spike — revenue halved, one related-party customer, family control, dividend stub.

sections.heading: Variant perception
sections.markdown:
**Market believes:** at Rp496 the plant is capitalised at $472.6m — $272.5m EV after $200.1m net cash, 1.8x my FY2027E EBITDA, a 10.8% net yield: the bear NAV.

**Why wrong:** volume never fell (756kt vs 740kt); the de-rating is price, set by a European cost curve with a third curtailed (§2, S8). On the audited 3-year EBIT ($76.6m) the plant is worth Rp627. The market refuses to pay for the related-party structure (F26).

**What proves us wrong:** an audited year below $400/t with the marker unrevised; the Senoro PJBG (28 October 2026, undisclosed terms, F40) failing the 65% pass-through; a dividend cut.

sections.heading: Disconfirming facts
sections.markdown:
1. Sole customer is a related party: 86.58% of revenue, 79.7% of receivables (F26/F49); terms "may differ" (§6).
2. Receivables +43.8% to $31.0m (F47/F48) while revenue fell 2.1% — timing or a credit concession (§3).
3. The $8.87m Akraya fee (F25) runs to the group dominating the register (§6).
4. Single train: a 34-day June 2026 turnaround cut H1 volume as price rose (S3).
5. FY2025's Rp52 dividend (F29) was 135% of earnings, from cash (S6); FY2023 paid 148.7% (dossier l.47).

sections.heading: Pre-mortem
sections.markdown: 2029, down 30%: Middle East capacity restarted what Europe curtailed, Chinese FOB settled at $400 (F42's top), the Senoro PJBG re-priced feedstock, and the dividend was cut with the earnings.

sections.heading: Bear attack
sections.markdown:
0. Fact-check. Revenue $295.0m (l.21; F1), realised $337.7/t (F21/F19), feedstock $153.7/t (F24/F19), 86.58% related-party (F26), net cash $125.6m (F13); Rp829 reproduces. [MINOR]

1. Marker circular. $445/t is a house FY2027E forecast, not a sourced series (method card §2). At the last actual $337.7/t: FCFF $38.4m, EV $433m → Rp489, below the Rp496 tape. The 67% upside is one unsourced forecast. [FATAL]

2. Variant perception is a risk premium. Rp496 is the bear NAV; base Rp829 carries no governance discount. 86.58% related-party revenue (F26), 79.7% receivables (F49), $8.87m Akraya fee (F25): the market may price it. [MATERIAL]

3. Catalyst is a price, not an event: Tampa (Dec), European gas (Jun), FY2026 results are observations; the tape saw Tampa $645 and Chinese FOB $510-535 (F41/F42) and still prices the bear. No dated catalyst. [MATERIAL]

4. Base rate right; payoff not. 0.42/+75/−35 gives EV +11.2%; the +16.0% compresses both legs to 38.17/−17.83. Peak-margin failure is live: H1 2026 realised $531/t (F34). [MATERIAL]

5. Structural. Kill Rp493 is 0.6% below Rp496; −17.83% is distance to kill, not executable loss. At the 25% band (limits l.184) it fills Rp370: −38.3% from 600, −25.4% from 496. At 600 EV is +4.0% (one band), −4.9% (two, the pre-mortem); up/|down| falls 3.39→1.0, so quarter-Kelly rounds to zero. The ARB gap is the loss leg. [FATAL]

6. Disconfirming fact. FY2023 payout 148.7% (l.47): $51.5m dividends against $34.6m net income (l.42, 25); cash fell $157.5m→$125.8m in FY2025 despite $96.1m FCF. The 8.9% yield is return of capital. [MATERIAL]

7. Steelman. Failure is earlier than 2029: the PJBG was signed 28 October 2026 (F40) on undisclosed terms, after the last audited cost line. If the formula is at the $200/t kill (F24/F19 = $153.7), the bear is base from Q1 2027. [MATERIAL]

8. Minority and pass-through. Base deducts 30% of EV ($262m) but adds 100% of net cash; if the cash sits in PAU, NAV is overstated ~Rp42/share (5%). The 65% pass-through of a 59%-exposed cost base is a calibration, not a contract. [MATERIAL]

9. Integrity. Clean: estimates committed 2026-11-06T13:15:53+07:00, body after, no retro-edits. [MINOR]

Verdict: **KILL_RECOMMENDED**

Strongest: The 67% upside is a house-forecast price, and its only loss leg is a kill 0.6% below the tape that fills one ARB band lower — executable EV is +4%, not +16%.

Stop: Rp440 (kill ≤420, ARB fill in ev_math); at Rp496 with a kill 0.6% away, no.

sections.heading: Revision
sections.markdown:

1. **Part-conceded (FATAL).** Not a loop — the deck never sees this thesis — but $445 is a forecast, not a sourced series. Re-run on audited numbers: FY2023-25 EBIT $77.0/$82.0/$70.8m (avg $76.6m), each embedding its own price and gas cost. FCFF $58.9m, EV $665m; 70% of (EV + $125.6m cash) + $15m LPG = $569m → **target Rp627**, −24%, bought by point 1. Rp829 stays the $445/t case.

sections.heading: Bear re-attack
sections.markdown:
1. 420/315 is a fair fill model: 315 is one ARB band under falsification and down_pct −28.4 carries the executable loss. "Review" at 420, falsification, lets a falsified position ride a band; exit_full belongs there. [MATERIAL]

Verdict: **SURVIVES_WITH_SCARS** — construction honest; no fillable price clears 15%.

sections.heading: Judge verdict
sections.markdown:
Correction against my record (35 KILL / 5 PASS_REDUCED / 0 fills; 12 of 28 scored kills left gains): I return mis-specified arithmetic instead of killing what it obscures, and I never kill a name whose business value supports a price I can name.

Chain verified: lint pass, stamps 13:15→13:55→14:16→15:03 monotonic, actors correct, both Bear logs verbatim; the target was cut, not raised. Grounds:

1. **The two-tier kill is a legitimate executable-fill model, not a device.** 315 is the limit-down fill of a 420 falsification on a 25% ARB band, and EV already charges the whole gap (−28.4%): conservative, not generous. The defect is "review" at 420 where exit_full belongs — a falsified position must not ride a band.
2. **The EV arithmetic is internally inconsistent, and it decides the trade.** At 440, +12.2% is the price-only formula; at the 496 tape, −0.6% is that formula plus ~10.5pp of dividend; "ex-carry +1.4" subtracts a yield the 12.2 never contained. Carry in both legs makes 440 +22.7% and clears the hurdle; price-only makes the tape −11.1%.
3. p_up 0.42 is the registry prior, unraised, cited; Rp627 reproduces on audited EBIT and the Bear bought it.

REVISE_CONSTRUCTION: one stated horizon, one dividend treatment, EV re-run at 440/429/496, 420 to exit_full. Not KILL: at 14.1% deployed against a 60-95% band, these merits deserve the test.

sections.heading: Revision
sections.markdown:
**1. Rp420 to `exit_full`.** Conceded: a falsified position must not ride a band. The 420 row now carries `action: exit_full`; Rp315 stays the ARB-adjusted fill and the `down_pct` leg (−28.4% from 440). Both price rows are exit_full, and 315 is listed first so the executed-loss check reads the fill, not the trigger.

**2. One horizon, one dividend treatment.** Stated horizon: **three years** (the archetype's `horizon_y`, base_rate "3y"). Treatment: **dividends on the up leg only, 9.4%/yr net = 28.2pp over three years; none on the kill leg**, which exits at the payout-failure state. This is the house V5.4 convention. EV = 0.42×(gain+28.2) + 0.58×(loss) − 1.0:
- 440: 0.42×(42.5+28.2) + 0.58×(−28.4) − 1.0 = **+12.2%**
- 429: 0.42×(46.2+28.2) + 0.58×(−26.6) − 1.0 = **+14.8%**
- 496: 0.42×(26.4+28.2) + 0.58×(−36.5) − 1.0 = **+0.8%**

**Hurdle.** Those are three-year totals. The 10.44%/yr bar compounds to 34.7% over three years. Annualised: 440 = 3.9%/yr, 429 = 4.7%/yr, 496 = 0.3%/yr. **No executable price clears.** The clearing price is Rp360, 14% below the Rp420 falsification — unreachable while the position is alive. The old "Rp429" solved EV against 15% *cumulative*, a horizon error. Carry in both legs (+28.6% at 440) annualises to 8.7%/yr, still short.

**3. p_up and target.** Unchanged: 0.42 registry prior, Rp627 on audited EBIT, Rp829 the $445/t case; no new evidence, no raise.

sections.heading: Judge verdict
sections.markdown:
**REVISE — construction defect; status attacked, no kill-ledger row, no cooldown.** ALDRICH (JUDGE), 2026-11-09T13:44:10+07:00. Correction applied: 35 KILL / 5 PASS_REDUCED / 0 fills, 12/28 kills left gains — return a mis-specified level set rather than kill a name whose business is intact.

Chain verified: lint PASS (one warning, 2,072 words > 1,600); stage_log monotonic 13:15→13:55→14:16→15:03→15:14→2026-11-09 13:25, actors correct; both Bear logs verbatim; committed estimates/model untouched; target Rp627 and p_up 0.42 unraised. No process defect.

1. The three prior defects are fixed: one horizon (3y), dividends up-leg only (28.2pp/3y, none on the kill leg), Rp420 now carries `exit_full`.

2. The hurdle arithmetic is right, and the clearing price ~Rp360 is verified (+34.7%/3y). It sits below the Rp420 falsification, so no executable entry above Rp420 clears. At Rp440 EV is +12.2%/3y = 3.9%/yr vs 10.44%/yr; even at zero downside Rp440 caps at +28.7%/3y (8.8%/yr) — sub-hurdle by construction, not by the ARB band alone.

3. LESSON-0004 bars a KILL: no KPI fired (realised $531/t > $400; feedstock $153.7 < $200) and no printed impairment (accruals negative, clean audit). Sub-hurdle here is a price/construction objection, not a thesis failure.

4. PASS-at-a-price is unavailable — the only price that pays is below the stop. The defect is the level set: Rp440 is tape-anchored, not hurdle-derived, and is inconsistent with an `exit_full` at Rp420. Re-derive the entry at the hurdle-clearing price with a business-falsification kill, or a target/payoff clearing an entry above Rp420; then rule on merits.
